messages:
maria: Thinking about splitting collector into a tiny agent (edge) + gateway (central) — thoughts? Need to keep per-tenant pipelines for spans/exporters, but avoid O(N) exporters per gateway. Any UX impact for console routes/quotas?

Dan: +1 on agent/gateway separation. Lightweight agent should only do OTLP->gateway, with local batching & transient cache. Keeps customer data in path minimal. :thumbsup:

reza: Concern: if gateway needs per-tenant pipelines (filtering, sampling, exporters), CPU/memory multiplies. We should consider a multitenant routing layer that maps tenant->pipeline config and shares exporter workers where possible.

kevin: What about dynamic pipeline composition? e.g. gateway holds pipeline templates + per-tenant policy (sample rate, retention TTL). That way we avoid duplicating exporter binaries; just parameterize.

olivia: UX question: how do customers set retention and per-route quotas? Console currently exposes global retention per dataset. We'd need routing policies page or embed in the existing "routes" flow.

maria: Proposal: agents tag spans with tenant-id + computed route. Gateway does policy evaluation (routing, sampling, quotas) and applies transmogrifier to map to backend exporters. Keep exporters pooled with sharding keys.

dan: Implementation notes: exporter pool keyed by (exporter-type, config-hash) so many tenants with same config share a worker.

reza: Sampling: prefer server-side probabilistic sampling at gateway to reduce downstream load. But we still need prefix-KV cache for repeated requests? (for spans, cache is less useful than logs)

kevin: Agree, do sampling + tail-based for errors. Also keep a "fast-path" : low-latency path that bypasses heavy processing for well-known low-cost tenants.

collector-bot: deploy metrics: gateway-1 cpu=68% mem=74% otlp_ingest_rps=42000 exporters_active=56

maria: If gateway gets 40k rps, exporter pool size & backpressure policy must be explicit. We also need a console dashboard: per-tenant ingest, sample rate, latency percentiles. Is that a Redwood Console ticket?

olivia: I'll open a console ticket. UX idea: routes page shows effective pipeline (visual) with toggles for sampling and retention, preview of data volume estimate.

dan: For config format, propose small DSL anchored on OTEL collector syntax. Example:

```
receivers:
  otlp:
processors:
  batch:
  probabilistic_sampler:
    sampling_ratio: 0.02
exporters:
  redwood_storage:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [probabilistic_sampler, batch]
      exporters: [redwood_storage]
```

kevin: Looks good. Add `tenant_id` label enforced on agent.

maria: Action items: kevin + reza to prototype gateway exporter-pool + config-hash sharing. olivia to draft routes UX mock. dan to spec sampling/backpressure SLOs. We'll sync Tue 10am.

olivia: noted. will attach mock links in ticket. :spiral_calendar:

maria: thanks all. leaning toward agent-edge + parametric gateway. close the loop next week.
